# Art While Apart Website

> Webiste for AWA, a collaborative effort to bring people and animals closer together through art.


[![ForTheBadge built-with-love](http://ForTheBadge.com/images/badges/built-with-love.svg)](https://GitHub.com/Naereen/) &nbsp;
![Magic](https://img.shields.io/badge/Made%20with-Magic-orange?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/svg%2bxml;base64,)

## Features

- The AWA website uses Netlify CMS as the content management system (CMS) for easily editing the pages that are frequently changed. The pages that are editable through the CMS are: Porfolio, Team, and Monthly Showcase.
- Website hosted on Netlify, with automatic deploys.
- Configurable manifest & global settings.
- CSS Markdown (Thanks to [https://github.com/iandinwoodie/github-markdown-tailwindcss/blob/master/markdown.css]).

## Techologies

- [Vue 2](https://vuejs.org)
- [Nuxt 2](https://nuxtjs.org)
- [Vuex](https://vuex.vuejs.org)
- [Netlify CMS](https://www.netlifycms.org)
- [Tailwind](https://tailwindcss.com)
- [Typescript](https://www.typescriptlang.org)

## Important Files & Folders

- **Website Pages** (app/pages): In this folder you'll find all the website pages.
- **Layouts** (app/layouts): There are two layouts, home and default. The home layout is made so that the hero section of the home page fills the whole height of the device. The default layout is used in all other pages of the webiste.
- **Netlify CMS Content** (app/content): In this folder you'll find all the JSON files used by the CMS. If someone edits, creates or removes a file through Netlify CMS UI, changes will be pushed to the Github repository, and the website will be automatically deployed to Netlify. To access Netlify CMS, go to [www.artwhileapart.org/admin](artwhileapart.org/admin).
- **Netlify CMS config** (app/admin/config.yml): General configuration for the CMS. Here you can see and edit all the fields and collections that show up in the CMS.
- **Nuxt Configuration** (nuxt.config.ts): This is Nuxt configuration file, includes fonts, favicon, css and optimization configuration.
- **Tailwind Configuration** (app/tailwind.config.js): This is Tailwind configuration file.
- **Vuex Store** (app/store/index.ts): You'll find the state, mutations and actions.
- **Shims** (app/shims/index.d.ts): Here are defined theTypeScript Interfaces for Netlify CMS fields
- **Get Content function** (app/utils.ts): This is the function that gets the content for us (everything inside app/content) so we can show the portfolio images, artists, staff, and OTMs in their respective pages of the website.

## Quickstart

### Prerequisites

- [Yarn](https://yarnpkg.com/lang/en/docs/install/#mac-tab)
- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en/)

```bash
# ensure you have the prerequisites installed (node and yarn)

# install dependencies
yarn install

# serve with hot reload at localhost:3000
yarn dev

# build for production with minification
yarn generate

# run all tests
yarn test
```

### Using Netlify CMS

1. Deploy to Netlify.
2. Enable Identity under Settings.
3. Configure registration preferences & external providers if needed.
4. Enable Git Gateway.

To use Netlify CMS locally:

1. Set `local_backend` to true in app/static/admin/config.yml
2. Run `npx netlify-cms-proxy-server` in your terminal
3. Start your local development server
4. Go to http://localhost:3000/admin to access the CMS. 

_Note: it won't work with IP address, it must be localhost, and make sure the port is the one of your local development server._
